summary: Public HTTP routes of the Axo Worker at axo.leostera.dev.

messages.name: GET /api/auth/cloudflare/start
messages.summary: Starts OAuth: sealed state + PKCE cookie, redirect to Cloudflare.

messages.name: GET /api/auth/cloudflare/callback
messages.summary: Verifies state, exchanges the code, maps the subject to an account, sets the session cookie.

messages.name: POST /api/v1/account/host-pairings
messages.summary: Creates a pairing code (10 min; ≤20 per minute).

messages.name: POST /api/v1/host-pairings/redeem
messages.summary: axod redeems a code with its credential verifier (≤4 KiB body; rate limited).

messages.name: GET /api/v1/account/hosts/:host/sessions/:session/events
messages.summary: Pages of stored Pi events (1 to 50 per page).

messages.name: POST /api/v1/account/hosts/:host/revoke
messages.summary: Unlinks a host and closes its relay.

messages.name: GET /api/v1/account/hosts/:host/client
messages.summary: WebSocket upgrade for a browser client (relay-host).

messages.name: GET /api/v1/accounts/:account/hosts/:host/daemon
messages.summary: WebSocket upgrade for a linked axod (relay-host).

parsing.summary: OAuth callback checks state, PKCE verifier, the fixed callback URI and an allowlisted return destination; identity is the verified subject, never email.
Bodies are size-limited and parsed with zod before use; mutating cookie routes check the exact Origin.

compatibility: Legacy /v1/* routes (synthetic edge principals, the unassigned private-fleet directory) coexist with account-scoped /api/v1/*. No removal condition is stated in code.
